name: Steward ACS — agent usage
description: Claude/chat vs coding + Meta-Harness rollups. Filter message agent.* / meta.* and signal. Dataset: steward_meta_analytics.

query.apl:
['__AGENT_OPS_DATASET__']
| where isnotnull(['signal'])
| summarize c=count() by bin(_time, 30m), signal

['__AGENT_OPS_DATASET__']
| where ['message'] == "agent.tool"
| summarize c=count() by bin(_time, 15m), audience

['__AGENT_OPS_DATASET__']
| where ['message'] == "agent.tool" and ['signal'] == "gap_empty"
| summarize n=count() by scope_path, tool_name, audience, org
| order by n desc
| limit 25

['__AGENT_OPS_DATASET__']
| where ['message'] == "agent.tool" and ['signal'] in ("misuse_discovery", "misuse_write")
| summarize n=count() by signal, tool_name, audience, org
| order by n desc
| limit 25

['__AGENT_OPS_DATASET__']
| where ['message'] == "agent.tool" and ['signal'] == "surprise_persist"
| project _time, tool_name, scope_path, kind, audience, org, agent_id, execution_chain_id
| order by _time desc
| limit 30

['__AGENT_OPS_DATASET__']
| where ['message'] == "agent.feedback"
| project _time, signal, audience, org, agent_id, guidance_useful, learned_for_agents, had_issues, improvements, info_needed
| order by _time desc
| limit 40

['__AGENT_OPS_DATASET__']
| where ['message'] == "agent.tool"
| summarize calls=count(), empty=countif(empty_result == true), failures=countif(status == "failure"), misuse=countif(signal startswith "misuse") by tool_name, tool_family, audience
| order by calls desc
| limit 25

['__AGENT_OPS_DATASET__']
| where ['message'] == "meta.summary"
| summarize sr=avg(success_rate), ops=sum(total_ops) by bin(_time, 1h)

['__AGENT_OPS_DATASET__']
| where ['message'] == "meta.tool"
| summarize calls=sum(total_calls), fails=sum(failure_count), avg_sr=avg(success_rate), p95=avg(p95_latency_ms) by tool_name
| order by fails desc
| limit 25

['__AGENT_OPS_DATASET__']
| where ['message'] == "meta.error_cluster"
| project _time, tool_name, error_type, occurrence_count, sample_message
| order by occurrence_count desc
| limit 30
